pictures.scene: Vicente Carducho, Batalla Fleurus - the pikes and the standards of two armies locked together on the open field with the smoke of the guns drifting across them, rescue me O LORD from evil men, protect me from men of violence who devise evil in their hearts and stir up war all day long
pictures.name: pd_carducho_geweld

pictures.scene: Maerten de Vos, Saint Paul Bitten by a Viper on the Island of Malta - the apostle bending over the fire with the viper fastened on his hand while the islanders draw back and watch him, they sharpen their tongues like snakes, the venom of vipers is on their lips
pictures.name: pd_devos_adder

pictures.scene: Giovanni Bellini, The Agony in the Garden - Christ kneeling in prayer on the bare rock while the armed band comes up the road behind him and his disciples sleep on, guard me O LORD from the hands of the wicked, keep me safe from men of violence who scheme to make me stumble
pictures.name: pd_bellini_bewaar

pictures.scene: Peter Paul Rubens, The Tribute Money - Christ with his hand lifted among the elders who press close around him with the coin, the proud hide a snare for me, the cords of their net are spread along the path
pictures.name: pd_rubens_strik

pictures.scene: Francisco Ribalta, San Francisco - the friar standing alone in his grey habit with his face lifted and his hands held open, I say to the LORD You are my God, hear O LORD my cry for help
pictures.name: pd_ribalta_mijn_god

pictures.scene: Blasco de Granen, Saint Michael the Archangel - the archangel standing armed over the dragon with his shield on his arm and his sword raised above his head, O GOD the Lord the strength of my salvation, You shield my head in the day of battle
pictures.name: pd_granen_schild

pictures.scene: Hendrick van Cleve III, The Construction of the Tower of Babel - the huge unfinished tower going up tier on tier over the ramps and the masons while the king comes down in his robes with his guard to see the work, grant not O LORD the desires of the wicked, do not promote their evil plans lest they be exalted
pictures.name: pd_cleve_toren

pictures.scene: Adam Colonia, Nachtelijke brand in een dorp - a village burning in the night with the flames going up out of the roofs and the people carrying out what they can save, may burning coals fall on them, may they be thrown into the fire
pictures.name: pd_colonia_vuur

pictures.scene: Winslow Homer, The Fox Hunt - the fox pushing through the deep snow along the shore while the crows come down on him out of the grey air, may no slanderer be established in the land, may calamity hunt down the man of violence
pictures.name: pd_homer_jaagt

pictures.scene: Jan Steen, Adolf en Catharina Croeser aan de Oude Delft - the seated gentleman holding the written petition and reaching out his hand to the poor woman who stands before him with her child and her basket, the LORD upholds justice for the poor and defends the cause of the needy, surely the righteous will praise Your name
pictures.name: pd_steen_behoeftige

lines.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.
Rescue me, O LORD, from evil men.
Protect me from men of violence,
who devise evil in their hearts
and stir up war all day long.
They sharpen their tongues like snakes;
the venom of vipers is on their lips.
Selah
Guard me, O LORD,
from the hands of the wicked.
Keep me safe from men of violence
who scheme to make me stumble.
The proud hide a snare for me;
the cords of their net are spread along the path,
and lures are set out for me.
Selah
I say to the LORD, “You are my God.”
Hear, O LORD, my cry for help.
O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation,
You shield my head in the day of battle.
Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked;
do not promote their evil plans,
lest they be exalted.
Selah
May the heads of those who surround me
be covered in the trouble their lips have caused.
May burning coals fall on them;
may they be thrown into the fire,
into the miry pits, never to rise again.
May no slanderer be established in the land;
may calamity hunt down the man of violence.
I know that the LORD upholds justice for the poor
and defends the cause of the needy.
Surely the righteous will praise Your name;
the upright will dwell in Your presence.
